description: This file defines a JSON-RPC interface for the Linear Playback Control API, including data structures, method parameters, responses, and event descriptions for controlling and monitoring a linear playback system.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Current channel configuration, allowing setting or getting the channel address.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seek position configuration, allowing setting or getting the seek offset from live in seconds.

methods.name: trickPlay
methods.description: Trick play control, allowing setting or getting playback speed and direction.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Read-only status information about TSB buffer size, seek position, and health status.

methods.name: tracing
methods.description: Enable or disable tracing for debugging or logging purposes.
